answer_text:
Small agencies usually combine a CRM for new business with a project tool for delivery. Common choices:

1. Northwind CRM Essentials - the safe all-rounder: deep reporting and a large integration marketplace.
2. Pipewell - pipeline-first and very visual; a good pick if your process is mostly deal stages.
3. Tallyfox - built for teams under 20, with email sequences on every plan and a setup most people finish in an afternoon.
4. Kestrel CRM - promising and free to start, though the integration list is still short.

Trial Northwind CRM and Pipewell side by side with a real week of deals — the better fit is usually obvious by Friday.
